impact: A read on the US consumer and housing ahead of Walmart on Thursday; little direct effect on his holdings, but steady consumer data supports the Fed's hawkish lean that pressures growth names.
summary: Home Depot's fiscal Q3 sales rose 4.9% to $43.4B and adjusted EPS was $3.86 vs $3.84 expected; comparable sales rose 2.2% vs about 1.8% expected, with online comps up about 13%. It narrowed its full-year comp outlook to about 1.4% growth and named Richard McPhail as CEO. Transactions fell 0.5% while average ticket rose 3%, and shares slipped premarket after a 20% run-up.
title: Home Depot beats with comps up 2.2%, names Richard McPhail CEO
